subject: Interest: Redwood GitHub integration — scheduling a short walkthrough
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@codeforge.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T15:02:00Z
Subject: Interested in Redwood GitHub integration

Hi Logan,

We signed up and kicked the tires on Redwood last week — really impressed by the model routing stuff. We maintain CodeForge, an open-source CI plugin with ~120k installs, and we want to explore a low-friction way to surface embeddings and light code intelligence for maintainers.

Two quick asks before a deeper call:
- Does Redwood support mounting a private repo token for on-prem connectors?
- Any guardrails for rate-limited public endpoints when you route to hosted models?

If useful, we can do a short 30-minute walkthrough next week. I’m in PST (Seattle).

Best,
Amit
Amit Shah
Director of Integrations, CodeForge
maintainers@codeforge.org

Hi Amit — great to hear from you and thanks for signing up. I’m Logan on the Integrations team. Short answers first: yes on private repo tokens (we surface a connector pattern and KMS-friendly secrets), and yes on rate limiting — we have per-tenant throttles plus circuit breakers and fallbacks to lighter-weight models. Happy to walk through the implementation patterns.

30 minutes sounds perfect. I have these slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-02 09:00–09:30 PST
- Tue 2026-11-02 13:00–13:30 PST
- Wed 2026-11-03 10:00–10:30 PST

If those don’t work, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll loop in Ben (AE) to cover commercial Qs. Also, quick question — are you hoping to embed inference in the CodeForge plugin (edge/on-device) or run via hosted Redwood endpoints? That helps me prep the right demo.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Integrations (SDR), Redwood Inference
